caption: Second year of recognition of Trinity International University of Ambassadors Corp. (FL), the TIUA School of Business, the Trinity International Chaplaincy Institute, & Trinity Girls Network Corp. and  establishing the TIUA International Day; recognize
summary: A RESOLUTION celebrating the second year of recognition of Trinity International University of Ambassadors Corp. (FL), the TIUA School of Business, the Trinity International Chaplaincy Institute, and Trinity Girls Network Corp. and establishing the TIUA International Day of Education in alignment with the International Day of Education; and for other purposes.
